varieties.name: Early Purple Top
varieties.season: 50 days to maturity; germinates in 7-10 days
varieties.traits: Smooth white skin, bright purple top, crisp cream-coloured flesh
varieties.note: Starke Ayres product page states the growing requirement directly as full sun for a summer/autumn crop, or a frost-free winter crop — read here as: grow it in summer/autumn wherever the zone allows, and only attempt a winter planting in the zones that are frost-free in winter (lowveld-bushveld, subtropical-coast). The winter-frost restriction is the source's own words, not this pass's inference.

evidence.quote: Turnip Early Purple Top. This vegetable seed is known to produce turnips with smooth, white skin, a bright purple top, and crisp cream-coloured flesh. Germination 7 to 10 days. Maturity 50 days. Location Full sun in Summer, Autumn and Winter frost-free areas.
evidence.doc: Turnip Early Purple Top Seeds, Starke Ayres product page

lowveld-bushveld.text: A frost-free winter zone: Early Purple Top can be grown in full sun year-round (summer, autumn AND winter) per the source's explicit 'Winter frost-free areas' condition.

evidence.quote: Location Full sun in Summer, Autumn and Winter frost-free areas.
evidence.doc: Turnip Early Purple Top Seeds, Starke Ayres product page

subtropical-coast.text: Same frost-free reasoning as lowveld-bushveld — inferred, not separately named by the source.

highveld.text: Hard-frost interior: limit this cultivar to the summer/autumn window the source names, since it does not claim winter (frost) suitability here.

evidence.quote: Location Full sun in Summer, Autumn and Winter frost-free areas.
evidence.doc: Turnip Early Purple Top Seeds, Starke Ayres product page

midlands-mistbelt.text: Same summer/autumn-only reasoning as highveld (light-to-moderate winter frost) — inferred, not source-confirmed by zone name.

gaps: Only one named cultivar found for the entire crop, from a single SA seed-company product page — no DAFF/KZN DARD production guide for turnip could be located this session (every guessed KZN DARD filename returned HTTP 404, and DAFF/nda.gov.za connections failed outright).
No sourced recommendation at all for western-cape, southern-cape, karoo-arid or high-mountain.

The source's zone language is only 'Summer, Autumn and Winter frost-free areas' — it does not name provinces or the brief's specific zone keys, so the highveld/midlands-mistbelt 'summer/autumn only' advice above is this pass's own reading of that sentence, not a verbatim zone-by-zone source statement.
No spacing, row spacing or yield-per-hectare data sourced for this cultivar.
